name: Lizard Island Resort
insider_take: This exclusive all-inclusive resort sits on a private 1,013-hectare island within the Great Barrier Reef Marine Park, offering unparalleled access to some of the world's most pristine coral reefs and the famous Cod Hole dive site.
whats_special: Lizard Island is one of only two resorts located directly on the Great Barrier Reef, with 24 powdery white sand beaches and world-class marlin fishing. The island serves as a research station for the Australian Museum, making it a living laboratory where guests can witness cutting-edge marine conservation in action.
pro_tip: Book the sunset helicopter transfer from Cairns – it's the most spectacular way to arrive and offers breathtaking aerial views of the reef that you'll remember forever.
dont_miss: The climb to Cook's Look, where Captain James Cook surveyed his escape route through the reef in 1770. The 360-degree panoramic views from the summit are absolutely stunning, and you'll be standing where one of history's greatest explorers once stood.
pros: Private island location on Great Barrier Reef
All-inclusive luxury with world-class diving and snorkeling
Exclusive beach access and pristine coral lagoons
Exceptional personalized service with high staff-to-guest ratio
cons: Remote location requires charter flight access
